amber-alert-info.looks: An image on the left; on a red panel to the right, an AMBER Alert icon, a title, text, a button and two figures.
amber-alert-info.use: Explaining AMBER Alerts with two headline figures, when asked.

amber-alerts.looks: Active AMBER Alerts, loaded live; hidden from visitors when none are active.
amber-alerts.use: Only on AMBER Alert and poster pages.

amber-still-missing.looks: An accordion listing children from past AMBER Alerts who are still missing, loaded live.
amber-still-missing.use: Only on the AMBER Alerts page.

apply-for-training.use: Only on its own page, when asked.

fields.bodyText: A run of article copy: paragraphs, lists, sub-headings and links.

article-details.looks: A blog article's header (title, author, date, header image under an optional overlay) and its body of text and image items.
article-details.use: Only on blog pages, which the backend generates.

fields.headerImage: The header image; the blog's thumbnail elsewhere on the site comes from it.
fields.heroContentPosition: left (default), center or right for the title over the header image.

article-list.looks: A searchable, filterable list of blog articles, loaded from the backend, with a load-more button.
article-list.use: Only on the blog listing page, when asked.

button.use: Only when the author asks for this component by name.
button.avoid: Use Custom Btn Icon (colored-button) for a standalone button.

fields.text: Rich text. Start with the title as a bold or heading line; put links inside the sentences.
fields.highlightText: Optional large text shown first, such as a figure ('1 in 5') or a short phrase.
fields.disclaimer: Optional fine print under the text, e.g. a source.
fields.image: Optional picture or logo at the top of the card. Give every card one or none.
fields.markerTerms: Optional words from this card's text, exactly as written, separated by |, to circle or underline.

card-row.looks: A grid of navy cards, each with a logo or small image at the top, a short paragraph and an outline 'Learn more' button. A vertical variant makes taller cards with a title, four per row.
card-row.use: Programmes or partner sites that each have their own logo.
card-row.avoid: No logos: use Multi Icn Btn Col Card Grid (info-cards-grid).

fields.variant: horizontal (default): larger cards, three per row, no title. vertical: taller cards with a title, four per row.
fields.columns: Optional cards per row, 1 to 6; empty keeps 3 (horizontal) or 4 (vertical).

card-row-compact.looks: A row of small white cards: an icon, a title, a short description and an optional text link.
card-row-compact.use: Linking to three to six related topics or data pages.
card-row-compact.avoid: Cards that need a paragraph or a button: use Multi Icn Btn Col Card Grid.

fields.columns: Cards per row, 1 to 6; empty keeps 4.
fields.alignment: left (default), center or right for everything in the cards.

fields.icon: A small icon; tinted with iconColor, or shown as is when that is empty.
fields.title: A few words.

card-row-detailed.looks: A row of tall light cards: an optional icon, a heading, a short paragraph, a bulleted list, a button, optional extra text and a second button.
card-row-detailed.use: Comparing two to four services or options, each with a list of what it includes.
card-row-detailed.avoid: Cards without lists: use Multi Icn Btn Col Card Grid.

fields.icon: Optional 96px icon at the top left.
fields.heading: The service or option, a few words.
fields.bulletList: A <ul> list of what the service includes.
fields.additionalText: Optional line between the two buttons, e.g. 'or'.

fields.logo: A logo or emblem; the card is built around it.
fields.title: Shown only with variant vertical.
fields.buttonText: The button's words, e.g. 'Learn more', with buttonLink.

card-testimonies.looks: A title and subtitle above quote cards: a main card with a photo and a larger quote, and smaller text-only quote cards. A second style uses a lighter, larger title.
card-testimonies.use: Quotes from families, survivors or partners.
card-testimonies.avoid: One quote on its own: use Custom Icon Text.

items.best: 1 main card (with image) and 2 to 4 small ones

fields.image: Add one for the large main card; leave empty for a small card.
fields.author: Name or role, e.g. 'Team HOPE participant'.

cards.looks: A grid of white cards, about three per row, each with an optional picture or logo, rich text whose links sit inside the sentences, optional large highlighted text (a figure or short phrase) above it and optional fine print below.
cards.use: Short notices or programme blurbs whose links sit inside the text, e.g. 'Missing Anniversaries … click here', or logos with a line about each partner.
cards.avoid: Cards that each need their own button: use Multi Icn Btn Col Card Grid (info-cards-grid). Cards built around a photo and a title: use Picture Cards or Image Card.

fields.textAlignment: left (default), center, right or justify for every card's text.
fields.imageDisplay: auto (default) fits logos and icons whole and crops photos to fill; logo or contain forces whole artwork; cover forces a crop.

case-anniversaries.looks: A searchable list of missing child case anniversaries, loaded live.

code-adam-kit.looks: The Code Adam kit request form.
code-adam-kit.use: Only on its own page, when asked.

colored-button.looks: One button on its own, with an icon on its right by default, aligned left, centre or right, or stretched full width. Solid, outlined or inverted.
colored-button.use: A standalone button between other blocks, e.g. under Custom Text.
colored-button.avoid: A button that belongs to a block with its own button fields: fill those.

fields.label: The button's words, e.g. 'Make a Report'.
fields.iconName: The icon drawn on the button, from the site's set: download (the default), external-link, phone, search, send, chevron-down, clock, heart, shield, alert. Change it to match the action, or set iconPosition to 'none'.
fields.iconPosition: right (default), left, or none for no icon. Use none unless an icon fits the action.
fields.icon: Optional uploaded icon image; replaces iconName.
fields.horizontalAlign: left (default), center, right, or stretch for full width. Match the copy above it.
fields.appearance: solid (default) filled, outlined (border only), or inverted (white fill, coloured text) for a dark background.

colored-grid.looks: A free-form grid: rows of 1 to 6 columns, each cell holding Custom Text, a heading, an image, Statistics, cards, a donut chart and more.
colored-grid.use: Only for a layout no designed block covers, such as a figure beside a photo beside text. Build it row by row.
colored-grid.avoid: Anything a designed block already does.

colored-heading.looks: A heading on its own, with a chosen level and alignment, and optional hand-drawn highlighted words.
colored-heading.use: A section heading above Custom Text, Custom List or a block without its own heading.
colored-heading.avoid: A heading for a block that has its own heading field: fill that instead.

fields.heading: Plain text, no links.
fields.headingLevel: h2 (default) for a section, h3 for a sub-section under an h2. Never h1: the hero holds the page's h1.
fields.horizontalAlign: left (default), center or right. Match the copy under it.
fields.blockBackgroundColor: Empty (default) is transparent. A colour paints a band behind the heading.
fields.markerTerms: Optional words from the heading to circle or underline, exactly as written, separated by |.

colored-icon-text.looks: A box with a circular photo, square photo or contained icon beside large bold text (about 32px): an optional small label that can be split in two colours, the main text (often a quote), an optional smaller second paragraph and an optional button.
colored-icon-text.use: A pull quote with its attribution, or one key point with an icon or portrait.
colored-icon-text.avoid: Several points in a row: use a card block. Long paragraphs: the main text is large, so keep it to one or two sentences.

fields.text: The main paragraph or quote, one or two sentences; it shows large and bold.
fields.text2: Optional second paragraph in normal size, e.g. the attribution '– Survivor, age 17'.
fields.label: Optional small label above the text, e.g. 'Survivor Story'.
fields.labelPart2: Optional second part of the label, shown after a divider in another colour.
fields.image: A portrait, photo or icon. Leave empty for text only.
fields.imageMode: circle (default) crops a photo to a circle, square keeps it square, icon shows artwork uncropped.
fields.buttonText: Optional button under the text, with buttonLink.
fields.blockBackgroundColor: The box colour; empty for no box.

colored-list.looks: A list with large styled markers: bullets, numbers, numbers in circles or bullets in circles.
colored-list.use: A list of points or steps that needs bigger or circled markers than a plain bulleted list.
colored-list.avoid: A short plain list inside copy: put a <ul> in Custom Text. Steps that each need a heading: use numbered cards.

fields.listStyle: bullet (default), number, circle-number (numbers in coloured circles) or circle-bullet. Steps → circle-number.

fields.itemText: One point: a sentence or two; bold a lead-in if the source does.
fields.markerText: Optional; replaces this item's number or bullet, e.g. a letter. Leave empty for automatic numbering.

colored-text.looks: Running copy: paragraphs, bulleted or numbered lists, sub-headings and links, aligned left, centre or right, optionally on a coloured band.
colored-text.use: Any copy that is not part of a designed block. The default for paragraphs.

fields.text: Rich text: paragraphs, <ul>/<ol> lists, <h3> sub-headings, links. A link alone on its own line becomes a button; end its text with ' [text link]' to keep it a link.
fields.horizontalAlign: left (default), center or right. Centre only short passages.
fields.blockBackgroundColor: Empty (default) is transparent. A colour paints a band behind the text, which picks a readable text colour itself.
fields.markerTerms: Optional words to circle or underline, exactly as written, separated by |.

columns.looks: Two or more columns side by side holding other content.
columns.use: Only when the author asks for columns.
columns.avoid: Prefer a designed block; columns are laid out by hand in the editor.

community-education-partner-reporting.looks: The Community Education Partner reporting form.
community-education-partner-reporting.use: Only on its own page, when asked.

connect-grid.looks: A heading and intro above a grid of warm-grey cards: an icon (or a photo across the top), a title, a short description, a divider, then up to four contact lines (a small label above the contact itself, as a link).
connect-grid.use: Ways to reach NCMEC or get help: phone numbers, email addresses, forms.
connect-grid.avoid: Cards with one button and no contact details: use Multi Icn Btn Col Card Grid.

fields.title: The service or team, e.g. 'CyberTipline'.
fields.icon: A line icon above the title.
fields.image: Optional photo across the top of the card; replaces the icon.
fields.contactMethod1Link: tel:, mailto: or a page, e.g. tel:18008435678.
fields.showDivider: show (default) draws a line between the description and the contact lines.

cta-card-1.looks: A full-width rounded band in a soft gradient: a heading and a sentence or two on the left, one or two buttons on the right (each with optional small text under it), and optional small print under the buttons. Four arrangements, from tall stacked buttons to a compact band with buttons side by side.
cta-card-1.use: Closing a section or page with one urgent action and an alternative, e.g. 'Is Your Child Missing?' with 'Call 911 Immediately' and '1-800-THE-LOST'.
cta-card-1.avoid: Several equal choices: use a card block. No action at all: use Custom Text.

fields.title: A short heading or question, e.g. 'Is Your Child Missing?'.
fields.subtitle: One or two sentences.
fields.buttonText: The main action, e.g. 'Call 911 Immediately', with buttonLink (tel: for a phone number).
fields.buttonSubtext: Optional small line on the button under its label, e.g. the number in digits.
fields.button2Subtext: Optional small line on the second button.
fields.belowButtonText: Optional small print under the buttons, e.g. hours or a note.
fields.button3Text: Shows only with styleType variant-4, under the text on the left.
fields.styleType: variant-1 (default): large buttons stacked on the right. variant-2: a shorter band with a smaller heading and buttons sized to their labels. variant-3: a very large first button, the small print, then a solid second button. variant-4: compact, the two buttons side by side, plus a third button on the left.
fields.button2Location: right (default) beside the first button, or left under the text.

cta-card-2.looks: A band with a large icon on the left, then a heading, a short paragraph and one button.
cta-card-2.use: Pointing people to one related service or page, e.g. 'Missing Child Clearinghouses' with 'Find Your Local Clearinghouse'.
cta-card-2.avoid: A photo instead of an icon: use Split Card.

fields.icon: A single line icon, not a photo.
fields.title: A few words.
fields.subtitle: Two or three sentences at most.
fields.backgroundColor: The band is a light tint of this colour (a few palette colours show solid); empty gives a light grey tint.

custom-image.looks: One image with an optional link and caption, at a chosen width and alignment.
custom-image.use: A standalone image, map, chart or infographic.
custom-image.avoid: A photo that goes with a paragraph: use Text Image or Split Card, which set them side by side.

fields.image: The image. Offer options with find_images unless the source gives a DAM path.
fields.imageAlt: What the image shows; for a chart, its main finding.
fields.captionText: Optional caption under the image, e.g. a source or credit.
fields.imageWidth: Share of the content column: width-25 to width-100, or empty for the image's own size. width-50 or width-66 suits a chart.
fields.imagePosition: align-left, align-center or align-right when the image is narrower than the column.

cybertipline-geo-report.looks: A US map or world list of CyberTipline report counts by state or country, loaded from the reports database.
cybertipline-geo-report.use: Only on CyberTipline data pages, when asked.

dark-feature-cards.looks: A dark navy panel with an optional title and subtitle, then a row of up to four dark cards: an optional photo across the top, a white icon, a bold title, a short paragraph and an optional button.
dark-feature-cards.use: Four parallel focus areas or priorities on a dark background, e.g. policy priorities.
dark-feature-cards.avoid: A light page section: use Multi Icn Btn Col Card Grid.

items.best: 4; more wrap into a second row

fields.cardTitle: Two to four short words. The cards are narrow, so long words break mid-word.
fields.icon: A line icon; it is tinted white.
fields.image: Optional photo across the top of the card (178px tall). Give every card one or none.

detailed-carousel.looks: A section title and description, then wide slides: a panoramic photo on top, three columns of title and text below it, and a button.
detailed-carousel.use: Several initiatives, each with three short facts or points.
detailed-carousel.avoid: One initiative: use Split Card with a card block.

fields.image: A wide panoramic photo; it is cropped to a letterbox shape.
fields.stat1Title: A few words or a figure; the column heading.

fields.icon: A small icon beside the title.
fields.title: Where the card goes, a few words, e.g. 'Search Missing Child Posters'.
fields.buttonText: Optional link words under the title.
fields.buttonLink: The address the whole card opens.

dual-cards.looks: Two white link cards side by side, each with a small icon and a title; the whole card is the link.
dual-cards.use: Two quick links, e.g. 'Search Missing Child Posters' and 'AMBER Alerts'.
dual-cards.avoid: Links that need a description: use Icon 1x4 Col Card (card-row-compact).

event-calendar.looks: Featured event cards above a month calendar and a table of upcoming events, loaded from the events database.
event-calendar.use: Only on events pages, when asked.

event-request-form.use: Only on its own page, when asked.

faon-application.looks: The Family Advocacy Outreach Network membership application form.
faon-application.use: Only on its own page, when asked.

faq.looks: An optional heading above a stack of question rows that open to show their answers.
faq.use: Questions and answers, or any set of topics where readers need only some of the answers.
faq.avoid: Two or three short answers everyone needs: show them as Custom Text.

fields.heading: Optional, e.g. 'Frequently Asked Questions'.
fields.preset: manual (default) for your own questions. amber-additional-info shows the fixed AMBER Alert content instead of items; only on the AMBER page.

fields.question: The question as a reader would ask it.
fields.answer: Rich text: paragraphs, lists and links.

featured-event.looks: An optional heading, then tall white event cards: a wide photo on top, a title, a one-line description, then up to four icon-and-label details (such as Duration, Location, For, Cost) and a button.
featured-event.use: Promoting one or a few specific events or trainings with their logistics.
featured-event.avoid: A schedule of many dates: use Training Sessions.

fields.title: Optional heading above the event cards.

fields.image: A wide photo (about 686x330).
fields.detail1Icon: Optional 32px icon for the detail, e.g. a clock for Duration.
fields.detail1Value: The value, e.g. '3 Days In-Person + Online'.
fields.ctaText: No arrow; the site adds one.

footer-banner.looks: A tall full-width photo fading to white, with a centred heading, a logo and a closing line.
footer-banner.use: A brand closing statement at the very end of a page.
footer-banner.avoid: Calls to action: use Hero Footer.

fields.image: A wide photo; its lower part fades to white.
fields.heading: One short line.

fragment.looks: Shows another page's content (a shared fragment) in place.
fragment.use: Only when the author names a fragment to include.

gallery-grid.looks: A grid of 2 to 4 equal columns of tiles: photos filling their slot, plain text tiles, or Statistics and card blocks placed directly in it.
gallery-grid.use: A mosaic mixing photos and big figures, e.g. in an impact report.

fields.image: A photo that fills this tile.
fields.text: Text for a plain text tile instead of a photo; ignored when there is an image.

general-inquiries.looks: The General Inquiries contact form (name, email, phone, topic, message), optionally beside a Team HOPE support panel.
general-inquiries.use: Only on a contact page, when asked.

hero.looks: The page opening: one large heading (the page's only h1) over a full-width photo or looping video under a soft white wash, with an optional breadcrumb trail, intro text, up to three buttons, a small badge image and an optional side panel. The text block sits left, centre or right.
hero.use: The first block of almost every page; one per page.
hero.avoid: A second hero further down the page: use Split Card or a CTA block there.

fields.content_text: The page heading, one line: it becomes the page's only h1 and extra lines fold into it. Under about 8 words.
fields.content_textHtml: One or two sentences under the heading. A link inside a sentence stays a text link.
fields.content_breadcrumbs: The trail above the heading, e.g. 'Get Help > Survivor Support'. It only shows when content_showBreadcrumbs is 'show'.
fields.content_showBreadcrumbs: Set to 'show' whenever you fill content_breadcrumbs; the default 'hide' hides the trail.
fields.content_position: Where the text sits over the photo: left (default), center or right. Pick the side the photo leaves clear.
fields.variant: 'homepage' is the taller home-page hero with a scroll cue, where words in [square brackets] in the heading turn blue. Only for the site's home page; everything else stays 'default'.
fields.media_image: The background photo, landscape, subject away from the text side. Offer options with find_images.
fields.media_imageAlt: Describe the photo in a short sentence.
fields.media_featuredImage: A small image, at most about 200px square, to the right of the text: a logo, seal or badge, never a photo.
fields.media_video: Optional looping background video (an MP4 in the DAM); the photo shows while it loads. Leave empty unless the source gives one.
fields.action_1Text: First button label, e.g. 'Make a Report'. Up to three buttons; fill 1, then 2, then 3, each with its link.
fields.panel_title: Optional box beside the heading for a key action or contact, e.g. 'Need help now?'. Leave every panel_ field empty for no panel.
fields.panel_text: One or two sentences in the side panel.
fields.panel_primaryText: Optional button in the side panel, with panel_primaryLink.
fields.panel_secondaryText: Optional text link under the panel button, with panel_secondaryLink.
fields.panel_footerText: Optional small print at the bottom of the panel, e.g. a phone number.
fields.panel_image: Optional image in the panel; used alone it shows on a clear background.
fields.markerTerms: Optional words from the heading or intro, exactly as written, separated by |, that get a hand-drawn circle or underline when scrolled into view. One short phrase at most.

hero-footer.looks: A centred closing statement on a light background with a large faint heart: a two-line heading (the second line larger), a paragraph and two buttons. A second style makes the first line red.
hero-footer.use: The last block of most pages: the mission line plus 'Subscribe to Updates' and 'Support NCMEC'.
hero-footer.avoid: A mid-page call to action: use a CTA block.

fields.heading_line1: The smaller first line, e.g. 'Every child deserves'.
fields.heading_line2: The larger second line, e.g. 'a safe childhood.'
fields.heading_subtext: One or two sentences under the heading.
fields.button1Text: First button, e.g. 'Subscribe to Updates', with button1.
fields.button2Text: Second button, e.g. 'Support NCMEC', with button2.
fields.image: Optional background image; leave empty for the standard light background.
fields.variant: default; variant-2 makes the first line red and medium-sized and the second line a section-heading size.

historical-reports-carousel.looks: A heading and intro above sliding cards for past reports: a cover image, the year, the report count and a download link.
historical-reports-carousel.avoid: A single report: use Img Btn Banner (report-download).

fields.reportCount: Optional figure shown under the year, e.g. '36.2 million reports'. Only figures the source gives.

historical-trends.looks: A heading, a large line chart of yearly values with the recent years highlighted, then a row of trend cards (title, text, link).
historical-trends.use: A multi-year trend with commentary, when the source gives the yearly figures.
historical-trends.avoid: Without real yearly figures from the source. Never make up chart values: the block comes pre-filled with sample figures, so replace or clear every pre-filled field.

fields.chartPoints: One per line as Year|Value, e.g. 2023|36200000.
fields.highlightFrom: The first year to colour as recent, e.g. 2021.

host-a-fundraiser.use: Only on its own page, when asked.

icon-card-carousel.looks: A section title and subtitle above a sliding row of light cards, each with an optional icon, a title, a short line and a button. Cards without icons are shorter. Thinner styles make narrower, taller cards.
icon-card-carousel.use: A browsable set of related items (publications, programmes) with a button each, more than fit across the page.
icon-card-carousel.avoid: Three or fewer items: use Multi Icn Btn Col Card Grid, which shows them all at once.

fields.heading: The section title.
fields.subtitle: One sentence under the title.
fields.styleVariant: default; thinner: narrower, taller cards; thinner-dynamic: the same with the content centred in each card.
fields.blockBackgroundColor: Optional band colour behind the whole carousel.

fields.icon: Optional line icon at the top of the card. Give every card one or none.
fields.heading: The card title, a few words.

icon-text.looks: A centred heading and one line with an icon, the first part of the line in red and the rest in blue.
icon-text.use: One short giving fact, e.g. '92% of every dollar' / 'goes directly to our child-serving operations.'

fields.heading: Optional heading above the line.
fields.icon: Optional small icon before the line.
fields.redText: The first part, e.g. '92% of every dollar'.

icon-text-row.looks: A row of up to four columns per row, each a coloured line icon above a short centred sentence. More items wrap to a new row.
icon-text-row.use: Warning signs, tips or facts that are one sentence each.
icon-text-row.avoid: Points that need a title and a paragraph: use Multi Icn Btn Col Card Grid.

fields.icon: A simple line icon (SVG or PNG); it is tinted with iconColor.

image-card.looks: A rounded banner with a full background photo under a colour wash, a large heading and up to two buttons.
image-card.use: A donation or campaign appeal with one or two actions.
image-card.avoid: An appeal without a photo: use a CTA card block.

fields.media_image: A wide photo; text sits over it, so a calm image works best.
fields.content_heading: One or two sentences; it is shown large.

image-text-card-row.looks: A row of tall cards: a picture at the top (often a document cover), an optional small icon, a title, a subtitle, a paragraph and a link, on a warm grey panel. A small-image style puts a cover thumbnail at the top left instead.
image-text-card-row.use: Publications, briefs or reports, each with a cover image and a link.
image-text-card-row.avoid: No images: use Multi Icn Btn Col Card Grid.

fields.imageStyle: default: the picture fills the top of the card. small: a 141x183 thumbnail at the top left, for document covers.
fields.imageAlign: Which part of a cropped picture stays visible: center (default), left or right.

fields.image: A cover or photo for the top of the card.
fields.icon: Optional small icon by the title.
fields.title: The publication's name.
fields.subtitle: Optional short line, e.g. the year or type.
fields.linkText: The link's words, e.g. 'Read the Brief'.
fields.cardContentBg: Panel colour under the picture; empty keeps warm grey.

impact-bar-chart.looks: A heading, intro and a bar chart (single or stacked) of a report dataset loaded from the reports database, with optional values on the bars, an optional data table and fine print.
impact-bar-chart.use: Only on impact or data report pages, when asked.

impact-chain.looks: A heading, then a zig-zag chain of cards joined by dotted lines; each card has a photo on one side and an icon, a coloured figure-title and a paragraph on the other, alternating sides.
impact-chain.use: Telling an impact story as a sequence of three to five results, e.g. '91% Recovery Rate'.
impact-chain.avoid: Results without photos: use Statistics or numbered cards.

fields.image: A photo for this step.
fields.icon: Optional small icon by the title.
fields.title: A figure with a few words, e.g. '91% Recovery Rate'.

impact-data-table.looks: A heading, intro and a table of a report dataset loaded from the reports database, with optional fine print.
impact-data-table.use: Only on impact or data report pages, when asked.

impact-donut.looks: A heading, text and a 2x2 set of large figures with labels on the left; a donut chart with a legend on the right; up to two buttons. White by default, or on a dark surface with white text.
impact-donut.use: How a whole divides into parts (e.g. 80% of spending on programmes) beside headline figures.
impact-donut.avoid: Figures without a whole to divide: use Statistics.

fields.heading: The heading.
fields.surfaceColor: The block colour; empty is white. With a dark colour set textMode to light.
fields.textMode: dark (default) for a light surface; light (white text) for a dark surface.

fields.itemType: stat (default): a figure on the left. segment: a slice of the donut, listed in its legend.
fields.label: What it is, a few words, e.g. 'Programs and services'.
fields.chartValue: Segments only: the number for the donut maths, e.g. 80. Segments should add up to 100. Empty uses value.
fields.color: Segments only: the slice colour. Give each segment a different one.

impact-geo-report.looks: A US map or world list of impact report counts by state or country, loaded from the reports database.
impact-geo-report.use: Only on impact report pages, when asked.

fields.icon: Optional line icon at the top of the card. Give every card an icon or none.
fields.title: The card heading, a few words.
fields.subtitle: Optional short line under the title.
fields.bodyContent: A paragraph, or a <ul>/<ol> list. Links inside become text links.
fields.overlayImage: A decorative background texture. Leave it empty unless asked.
fields.cardBackgroundColor: The card colour; empty keeps the default dark navy. The text switches to a readable colour on its own.
fields.iconLayout: Empty puts the icon above the title; left puts it beside the title.
fields.cardStyle: Only with the block's volunteer style: filled or outline (dashed border).

info-cards-grid.looks: An optional heading and intro (with an optional button beside it) above a grid of 1 to 4 cards per row. Each card has an optional icon (above the title or beside it), a title, a subtitle, body text that can be a bulleted or numbered list, and up to two buttons. Cards are dark navy with white text by default; any card colour works.
info-cards-grid.use: The workhorse for grouping topics, services or audiences, with or without icons. The safe default when there are no images.
info-cards-grid.avoid: Cards built around photos: use Picture Cards or Image Text Card Row.

fields.sectionSubheading: One or two sentences under the heading.
fields.introButtonText: Optional button beside the heading, with introButtonLink.
fields.sectionButtonText: Optional button under the grid, e.g. 'View All', with sectionButtonLink.
fields.footerText: Optional small text under the grid.
fields.columns: Cards per row: 1 to 4 (default 3). Match the card count: 2, 4 or 8 cards → 2 or 4; 3, 6 or 9 → 3.
fields.headerAlignment: left (default) or center for the heading and intro.
fields.cardContentAlignment: left (default) or center for everything inside the cards. Centre suits short cards with icons.
fields.styleVariant: default; volunteer puts the whole grid on a warm beige rounded panel with lighter, softer cards (each card can then be filled or dashed-outline via cardStyle); button-top gives a wider heading with the intro button at the top right.

fields.sectionName: The group this leader belongs to, e.g. 'Board of Directors'; cards with the same name are grouped together.

leadership-header.looks: The leadership page heading and intro.

leadership-overview.looks: A heading and intro, a featured leader with photo and quote, and navy cards linking to leadership pages.
leadership-overview.use: Only on About pages, when asked.

leadership-profile.looks: One leader's photo, name, title and biography.
leadership-profile.use: Only on a leader's bio page.

leadership-team.looks: A grid of leader cards (photo, name, role, short bio, link to the bio page), grouped under section names such as 'Leadership' and 'Board of Directors'.

logo-carousel.looks: A thin strip of partner logos that scrolls sideways, with arrows.
logo-carousel.use: Partner, sponsor or member logos with no text.
logo-carousel.avoid: Logos with partner quotes: use Partners Showcase.

fields.logo: The organisation's logo, ideally on a transparent or white background.
fields.logoLink: Optional link to the organisation's site.

mail-address.looks: A small card with an icon, a heading and a postal address.
mail-address.use: A mailing address for donations or letters.

fields.heading: e.g. 'Mail a Donation'.
fields.address: The address, one line per line of the envelope.

media-contact-cta.looks: A dark navy band with a small icon, a heading, a sentence that ends in an email address, and a line of small print.
media-contact-cta.use: The press contact at the end of a media or newsroom page.
media-contact-cta.avoid: Any contact that is not an email: use CTA Support or Icon Hyperlink 1x3 Col Card.

fields.heading: Pre-filled 'Contact Our Media Team', as are the other fields with the media team's details: keep them only for the media contact.
fields.copy: The words before the email, e.g. 'For interview requests, B-roll, or expert commentary:'.
fields.email: The address only, e.g. media@ncmec.org. It becomes a mail link.
fields.note: Small print, e.g. what to include in a request.
fields.image: Optional small icon.

media-reporting-info.looks: A heading and intro above three columns, each a small heading and a paragraph.
media-reporting-info.use: Three short parallel points with no icons or links.
media-reporting-info.avoid: Points with icons or links: use Multi Icn Btn Col Card Grid.

fields.heading: Every text field comes pre-filled with the media team's anniversary wording: replace each one, or keep it only on a media page that uses it.

mega-nav.use: Only on the /nav page, never on a content page.

missing-child-poster-api-registration.looks: The Missing Child Poster API registration form.
missing-child-poster-api-registration.use: Only on its own page, when asked.

missing-child-quick-report.looks: The Missing Child Quick Report form, with an emergency notice beside it.
missing-child-quick-report.use: Only on its own page, when asked.

ncmec-reprint-request.use: Only on its own page, when asked.

need-help.looks: A rounded tinted panel with a centred heading and intro, and a row of white cards (a title, a short line and a link each).
need-help.use: Contact options for a specific audience near the end of a page, e.g. a hotline, an email and a report form.
need-help.avoid: Cards that need icons or longer text: use Multi Icn Btn Col Card Grid.

fields.title: The contact or service, a few words, e.g. 'Call 1-800-THE-LOST'.
fields.subheading: One short line, e.g. 'Available 24 hours a day'.
fields.linkText: The link's words, e.g. 'Call now', with linkUrl (tel:, mailto: or a page).

news.looks: A heading with an optional button, then cards for news and blog posts (photo, tags, title, summary, link), optionally led by one large featured card. It can fill itself with the newest blogs, on one topic if you choose.
news.use: A latest-news or related-blogs section, when the author or document asks for one.

fields.heading: e.g. 'Latest News'.
fields.headerButtonText: Optional button beside the heading, e.g. 'View All News', with headerButtonLink.
fields.button: Optional 'View More' button under the cards.
fields.blogFeed: Adds the 3, 4, 6 or 9 newest blogs after any cards you add by hand. Use it instead of adding items when the document asks for the latest posts.
fields.blogFilter: Limits blogFeed to one area, topic, story type or program, e.g. a topic page's own topic. Empty = any topic.
fields.featuredMode: featured shows the first card large; none (default) keeps every card the same size.

fields.blog: A blog page to fill this card from (/content/edge/resources/Blogs/…): its image, title, summary and tags. Anything typed in the other fields wins.
fields.title: Only when not pulling from a blog: the article title.
fields.subtitle: Only when not pulling from a blog: one or two sentences.
fields.link: Only when not pulling from a blog: where the card goes.
fields.tags: Optional, one per line; leave empty to use the blog's own tags.

newsletter.looks: A sign-up band: a background photo, a heading, a short line and either a newsletter picker (a dropdown that opens the chosen newsletter's sign-up page) or an email field with a button.
newsletter.use: Near the end of a page, when the author asks for a sign-up.

fields.form_type: dropdown (default): a list of newsletters, each opening its own sign-up page (form_options, one Label|URL per line). input: an email field that subscribes directly.
fields.form_options: For dropdown only: one newsletter per line as Label|URL.

numbered-cards.looks: A title and subtitle, then dark navy cards numbered automatically (1, 2, 3 ...) in outlined boxes, each with a bold title and a short paragraph; shown as a grid of 2 to 4 per row or as a carousel.
numbered-cards.use: Ordered steps or tips, e.g. 'What To Do' after sextortion.
numbered-cards.avoid: Points with no order: use Multi Icn Btn Col Card Grid. Milestones with their own years: use numbered-cards-custom.

fields.title: The heading above the cards.
fields.subtitle: Optional sentence under the heading.
fields.textAlign: left (default), center or right for the title and subtitle.
fields.layout: grid (default) shows every card; carousel slides them, for six or more long cards.
fields.cardsPerRow: Grid only: 2, 3 or 4 (default). Match the card count: 3 or 6 cards → 3.
fields.blockBackgroundColor: Optional band colour behind the whole block.

numbered-cards-custom.looks: An optional logo or image at the top and a title, then dark cards in a scrolling row (or a grid), each with its own number or year, a title, a sentence and an optional link.
numbered-cards-custom.use: A timeline or milestones where each card has its own label, e.g. 1981, 1984, 1998.
numbered-cards-custom.avoid: Plain ordered steps: use Dark Seq Btn 1x8 Card Grid Carousel (numbered-cards), which numbers them for you.

fields.headerImage: Optional logo or image above the title.
fields.title: The heading above the cards.
fields.subtitle: Optional sentence under the heading.
fields.layout: carousel (default) scrolls the cards; grid shows them all, cardsPerRow to a row.

fields.cardNumber: The year or number at the top of the card, e.g. '1984'.

fields.cardTitle: A short instruction, e.g. 'Don't pay or comply.' Do not type the number; it is added.

partners-showcase.looks: A heading and intro, a continuously scrolling strip of partner logos, then quote cards from partners (logo, quote, name, title), and an optional button.
partners-showcase.use: Corporate partners and what they say about NCMEC.
partners-showcase.avoid: Logos with no quotes: use Logo Carousel.

fields.heading: e.g. 'Our Partners'.
fields.ctaText: Optional button under the quotes, e.g. 'Become a Partner', with ctaLink.

fields.itemType: logo (default) for the scrolling strip; testimonial for a quote card. Add logos first, then testimonials.
fields.logoLink: Optional link to the partner's site.
fields.attributionName: Testimonial items only: who said it.
fields.attributionTitle: Testimonial items only: their role and company.

picture-cards.looks: A section heading and subheading above photo cards, three per row (two on tablets, one on phones), with the title and text laid over the lower part of each 3:2 photo; a card can be a link.
picture-cards.use: Visual topic or skill tiles with short captions.
picture-cards.avoid: Cards whose text needs more than two sentences: the text sits on the photo, so use Image Text Card Row.

fields.image: A photo; it is cropped to 3:2 with the text over its lower part, so choose one whose subject sits high.
fields.title: A few words.
fields.link: Optional page the whole card opens.

poster-map.looks: A map image with standard and advanced poster search links.
poster-map.use: Only on the missing children posters page.

poster-results.looks: The missing child poster search form and its results.
poster-results.use: Only on the missing children posters page.

prpl-application.use: Only on its own page, when asked.

fields.image: A photo or illustration; it is cropped to a circle.
fields.title: A short name, e.g. 'Florida'.
fields.buttonText: Optional button, e.g. 'Learn More', with buttonLink.

regional-offices.looks: A centred heading and intro above a row of 2 to 4 columns; each column has an image in a soft circle, a title, a short paragraph and an outline button. A boxed style puts each column's text in a white box.
regional-offices.use: A small set of parallel places, offices or options that each have a picture and a link, e.g. regional offices.
regional-offices.avoid: Without images: use Multi Icn Btn Col Card Grid (info-cards-grid) or Icon 1x4 Col Card (card-row-compact).

fields.heading: The heading above the columns.
fields.columns: Columns per row: 2, 3 (default) or 4. Match the number of items.
fields.stylingVariant: default: open columns. boxed: each column's text sits in a white rounded box of equal height.

related-articles.looks: A row of three cards for related blogs or resources, picked automatically from the page's own tags, with up to three pinned first.
related-articles.use: Only at the end of blog or resource pages, when asked.

fields.heading: Pre-filled 'Related Blogs'.
fields.pinned1: Optional page to show first: a blog page on a blog, a resource page on a resource. The rest fill automatically.

report-archive.looks: An accordion of years; each opens to a cover image beside a list of PDF links.
report-archive.use: An archive of yearly report downloads, newest year first.

fields.links: A <ul> list of links to the PDFs.

report-breakdown.looks: A heading, a year switcher, and a chart with a table of report types for the chosen year, loaded from the reports database.
report-breakdown.use: Only on CyberTipline or impact data pages, when asked.

report-download.looks: A light panel with two overlapping report covers on the left, a heading and short text in the middle, and a download button on the right.
report-download.use: Offering one report or PDF to download.
report-download.avoid: Several reports: use Report Archive or Historical Trends Carousel.

fields.backImage: An inside page or second cover, shown behind and offset. Optional.
fields.heading: The report's name.
fields.bodyText: One or two sentences about it.
fields.buttonLink: The PDF: a /content/dam/… path or a URL.

report-section-nav.looks: A sticky bar of in-page links to sections further down the page.
report-section-nav.use: Long pages with several named sections, when asked.

fields.links: One per line as Label|#section-id. Each id must exist on the page. Pre-filled with the CyberTipline report's sections: replace them.
fields.label: A name for screen readers, e.g. 'Page sections'.

resource-details.looks: A resource page's header (title, author, header image) and body.
resource-details.use: Only on resource pages, which the backend generates.

fields.itemTitle: Optional display title; falls back to the resource title or file name.
fields.itemDescription: Optional line about what the file contains.
fields.buttonLabel: Optional; defaults by file type, e.g. 'Download PDF'.

resource-downloads.looks: The download cards for a resource: each card has a thumbnail, title, description, audience/format/time details and a download or watch button. Gated files ask for registration first.
resource-downloads.use: Only on resource pages, which the backend generates.

fields.slug: Filled automatically: the resource this page belongs to. Leave it.

resource-hero.looks: The resource page opening: breadcrumb, title, intro, body text, 'Watch Video' and 'Download Resource' buttons, and a hero image.
resource-hero.use: Only on resource pages, which the backend generates.

fields.resourceBody: The resource description: a paragraph or two, lists allowed.
fields.content_breadcrumbs: e.g. 'Resources > NetSmartz'; Label::/path makes a crumb a link.
fields.watchLabel: The video button's words; the button shows only when a video is set.
fields.downloadLabel: The download button's words; the button shows only when a file or URL is set.

fields.image: A landscape photo for the top of the card.
fields.icon: Optional small icon above the title.
fields.title: The audience or resource, a few words.
fields.subtitle: One sentence about it.
fields.tags: Optional; leave empty unless the source gives tags.

resource-tags.looks: Hidden tags for the resource library (shows nothing on the page).
resource-tags.use: Only on resource pages, which the backend generates.

resource-video-hero.looks: The video resource page opening, filled from the resource library: title, description, a link back to the listing, and Watch and Download buttons.
resource-video-hero.use: Only on generated video resource pages.

resources.looks: A heading with a button at the top right, then a sliding row of white cards: a photo, a small icon, a title, a short description and a 'Learn More' link. It can show resource library records instead of hand-made cards.
resources.use: Pointing to audience pages or resources, e.g. 'For Families', 'For Law Enforcement', four or more of them.
resources.avoid: Fewer than three cards: use Picture Cards or Image Text Card Row, which do not slide.

fields.heading: The heading above the cards.
fields.button: The words on the top-right button, e.g. 'View All Resources', with buttonLink.
fields.settings: Library settings. Leave as they are.
fields.apiBaseUrl: Library settings. Leave as they are; with it set, library records replace hand-made cards.
fields.selected: Library settings. Leave as they are.
fields.limit: Library settings. Leave as they are.

resources-browser.looks: The searchable, filterable resource library: a heading, intro, search box, filter menus and pages of resource cards loaded from the library.

fields.heading: The library page's heading.
fields.bodyText: Optional intro between the heading and the search box.
fields.library: Which library this page lists and how its filters are worded: prevention, general, or both. Copy it from a similar existing page.

resources-carousel.looks: A sliding row of related resources or articles, filled from the resource library based on the page it sits on, with a 'find all' button.
resources-carousel.use: Only on resource and article pages, when asked.

fields.heading: Pre-filled 'Related Resources'.
fields.programs: Optional program filter, e.g. kidsmartz or netsmartz.

section-title.looks: A section's heading with an optional intro paragraph and an optional button, aligned left, centre or right.
section-title.use: Opening a section whose blocks have no heading of their own, e.g. above a row of cards.
section-title.avoid: A heading alone with nothing else: Custom Heading is lighter.

fields.title: The heading. Each paragraph shows on its own line.
fields.subtitle: One or two sentences.
fields.buttonText: Optional button under the intro, with buttonLink.
fields.textAlign: left (default), center or right. Match the block below: centre over centred cards.

site-search.looks: The site search box and results.

social-report-cta.looks: A dark panel: a small label, a heading, a line of intro and social media icons on one side and, optionally, a report cover with a heading, text and download button on the other.
social-report-cta.use: The end of a data or report page: follow NCMEC on social media, plus a download of the full report.

fields.eyebrow: Small label above the heading; pre-filled 'Stay connected'.
fields.socialHeading: Pre-filled 'Connect with us on social media'; keep or replace.
fields.socialIntro: Pre-filled one-line intro; keep or replace.
fields.facebookLink: Full profile URL. An empty social link hides its icon.
fields.reportHeading: Leave all the report fields empty to show only the social panel.
fields.reportButtonText: e.g. 'Download the Full Report'; shows only with reportButtonLink.
fields.reportButtonLink: The report PDF (/content/dam/… or a URL).

split-card.looks: A large card split in two: a photo filling one half; a heading, a paragraph and one or two buttons on a white panel on the other half. A lighter style drops the panel and shows a smaller rounded photo.
split-card.use: Introducing one programme, service or idea with a photo; the site's most common feature card. Several in a row make an alternating feature list (flip imagePosition each time).
split-card.avoid: No photo: use Section Title, or Custom Text with a Custom Btn Icon.

fields.heading: A few words.
fields.subheading: The paragraph, two to four sentences. Rich text; a link inside a sentence stays a text link.
fields.image: A photo; it is cropped to fill its half.
fields.buttonSubtext: Optional small line under the button.
fields.button2Subtext: Optional small line under the second button.
fields.imagePosition: left (default) or right. Alternate it when stacking several split cards.
fields.imageSize: even (default, half and half) or smaller (a 500px photo, more room for text).
fields.stylingVariant: default: white panel beside a full-height photo. variant-2: no panel, a smaller rounded photo and grey text, for a quieter look.
fields.headingLevel: heading-h3 (default) when the card sits under a section heading; heading-h2 when the card itself opens a section.

split-card-carousel.looks: A section title, then wide white slides shown one at a time: a photo on the left; a heading, text and up to two buttons on the right; dots and arrows underneath. Other styles show fixed-size cards with a 300px photo and a soft shadow.
split-card-carousel.use: Events, stories or programmes shown in turn, e.g. regional events.
split-card-carousel.avoid: A single item: use Split Card.

fields.heading: Optional section title above the slides.
fields.variant: default: full-width slides with arrows and dots. variant-2: fixed-size cards with a narrow photo and a soft shadow, text always left-aligned. variant-3: another compact card layout. Keep default unless asked.

fields.image: A photo; it fills the slide's left side.
fields.heading: A few words.
fields.contentAlign: left, center or right for this slide's text.

split-card-detail.looks: A 2x2 grid of small white cards (icon, title, sentence) beside a large photo.
split-card-detail.use: Four values or benefits next to a photo.
split-card-detail.avoid: No photo: use Multi Icn Btn Col Card Grid.

split-card-gap.looks: Two panels side by side: a photo on the left; on the right a heading, a paragraph, a 2x2 grid of small icon-and-label benefits, and up to two buttons. A second style shows a large rounded photo and no panel.
split-card-gap.use: A recruiting or programme pitch with two to four short benefits, e.g. 'Join Our Team'.
split-card-gap.avoid: Benefits that need a sentence each: use Split Card plus a card block.

fields.heading: A few words; each paragraph shows on its own line.
fields.bodyText: One or two sentences above the benefits.
fields.stylingType: default: photo beside a coloured panel. variant-2: a large rounded photo with the text beside it and no panel.
fields.headingLevel: heading-h3 (default) under a section heading; heading-h2 when the block opens a section.

fields.title: A one to three word benefit, e.g. 'Mission-Driven'.
fields.icon: A small line icon; it is tinted with iconColor.

split-card-info.looks: An image on the left inside a coloured shape; on the right a programme logo, a large figure followed by a few words, a paragraph and a button.
split-card-info.use: One programme with a headline figure, e.g. the CyberTipline with '20,512,803 total reports of suspected child sexual exploitation online'.
split-card-info.avoid: No headline figure: use Split Card.

fields.mainImage: A photo for the left side.
fields.subheading: Figure first, then the words: '20,512,803 people served'. The figure is shown large.
fields.heading: Optional; often left empty when there is a logo.
fields.imageSplit: half (default): the image takes half the width. third: a narrower image and more room for text.

split-card-list.looks: A heading, a paragraph and a button on the left; on the right a stacked list of white rows: either statements (title, subtitle, year and a 'Read Statement' button) or dark email cards (icon, title and an email address).
split-card-list.use: Testimony or statement archives, or a list of contact email addresses.

fields.heading: The left-hand heading.
fields.buttonText: Optional button under the text, with buttonLink.
fields.layout: statements (default) or email-cards. Item fields marked for one layout are ignored in the other.

fields.title: The statement's or contact's title.
fields.subtitle: Statements only: e.g. the hearing or committee.
fields.buttonText: Statements only: e.g. 'Read Statement', with buttonLink.
fields.emailText: The address only, e.g. info@ncmec.org (email-cards layout).

split-card-offices.looks: Two columns: a large statement in big type on the left; on the right a contact card with an icon, a heading, up to two icon-and-text detail lines and up to two buttons.
split-card-offices.use: One office's or team's contact details with a short statement.
split-card-offices.avoid: Several offices: use Img Btn 1-3 Col Card (regional-offices) or Icon Hyperlink 1x3 Col Card (connect-grid).

fields.feature1Heading: The card heading, e.g. 'NCMEC Texas Regional Office'.
fields.feature1Icon: Optional 48px icon above the card heading.
fields.feature2Text: A detail line, e.g. the street address.
fields.feature3Text: Another detail, e.g. the phone number.

split-thin-carousel.looks: A section title, then large slides shown one at a time: a photo on the left; a heading, paragraphs, a button and an optional text link on the right; dots and arrows underneath.
split-thin-carousel.use: Featuring several programmes in turn, each with a photo and a call to action.
split-thin-carousel.avoid: A single programme: use Split Card.

fields.heading: A few words.
fields.linkText: Optional extra text link under the button, with linkUrl.

statistics.looks: An optional heading and intro, then a row of large figures that count up when scrolled into view, each with a short label under it (optionally a small label above, an icon and a button), with dividers between figures and optional fine print under the row. Long rows wrap into balanced rows.
statistics.use: Two to six headline numbers that belong together. Figures from different topics, or more than six, read better as two blocks with their own headings.
statistics.avoid: Figures that each need a sentence: use a card block or Custom Text.

fields.heading: Optional heading above the figures.
fields.bodyText: Optional intro sentence under the heading.
fields.statValues: Legacy. Leave empty; use one item per figure.
fields.statLabels: Legacy. Leave empty; use one item per figure.
fields.iconImage: Only for a block with a single figure; with several, each item has its own icon.
fields.defaultButtonText: Only for a block with a single figure; with several, each item has its own button.
fields.disclaimer: Optional fine print under the figures, e.g. the data source and year.
fields.contentAlignment: center (default) centres the heading and figures; left or right lines them up on that side.
fields.blockBackgroundColor: Empty (default) leaves the block on the page background; a colour paints a band behind the whole block.
fields.markerTerms: Optional words or a figure, exactly as written, separated by |, that get a hand-drawn circle or underline when scrolled into view.

fields.statValue: The figure alone, e.g. '145,000+', '92%', '1 in 7'. Numbers count up on scroll; words go in statLabel.
fields.statLabel: What the figure counts, a few words, e.g. 'reports of online enticement'.
fields.statTopLabel: Optional small line above the figure, e.g. a year.
fields.image: Optional small icon above the figure. Give every item an icon or none.
fields.buttonText: Optional button under this figure, with buttonLink. Give every item a button or none.

support-cta.looks: A centred, rounded warm-beige panel: a large heading, one line under it, one large button with a second line on it, and a line of helper text under the button.
support-cta.use: A single phone or contact call to action, e.g. 'Ready to talk? Call Team HOPE today.'
support-cta.avoid: More than one action: use a CTA card block.

fields.heading: One short line. Comes pre-filled with the Team HOPE wording, as do the other text fields: replace each, or clear one you do not need.
fields.buttonSubtext: Second line on the button, e.g. the number in digits.
fields.buttonLink: For a phone number use tel:, e.g. tel:18663054673.
fields.helperText: One small line under the button.

tabs.looks: A heading, a row of tab buttons (with optional icons) and, under the selected tab, a grid of 2 to 4 white cards per row, each with a title, text or bullets and a link.
tabs.use: Many cards that fall into three to six categories readers switch between, e.g. resources by audience.
tabs.avoid: The assistant cannot yet set which tab a card belongs to (a multi-select), so every card shows under the first tab until the author sets it. Use Tabs only when asked, and list that as a gap. Fewer than about eight cards: use a card grid instead.

fields.heading: The heading above the tabs.
fields.columns: Cards per row under each tab: 2, 3 or 4 (default).

fields.title: The card heading, a few words.
fields.bodyContent: A sentence or a short bulleted list.

fields.label: The tab's words, one or two, e.g. 'Parents'. Pre-filled with 'Tab': replace it.
fields.icon: Optional small dark icon left of the label; it is recoloured to white on the active tab.

team-hope-volunteer.looks: The Team HOPE volunteer application form.
team-hope-volunteer.use: Only on its own page, when asked.

text-image.looks: A text column (a small label, a large heading, a paragraph and a button) beside a photo, with an optional caption box laid over the photo. Styles: a rounded coloured box (default), photo on the left, or open layouts without a box for long editorial copy or a very large heading.
text-image.use: A mission statement or key message beside a photo, or a longer passage of editorial copy with a photo (variant-2).
text-image.avoid: Several stacked image-and-text rows: Split Card is the site's standard for those.

fields.subhead: Optional small label above the heading, e.g. 'Mission'.
fields.heading: A few words.
fields.bodyText: One paragraph by default; several paragraphs and lists with variant-2.
fields.image: A photo beside the text.
fields.imageOverlayHeader: Optional short quote or caption shown in a box over the photo.
fields.imageOverlayText: Optional text inside the overlay box.
fields.imageOverlaySubtext: Optional attribution inside the overlay box.
fields.styleVariant: default: text and photo in a rounded coloured box, photo right. image-left: the same with the photo left. variant-2: no box; a section-size heading and room for several paragraphs. variant-3: no box; a very large heading centred beside the photo. variant-4: no box; a wide fixed photo with the text top-aligned.
fields.backgroundColor: The box colour in the default and image-left styles.

training-sessions.looks: A title and text above a list of rows: a bold first column, two more columns, a coloured status and an arrow link.
training-sessions.use: A schedule of sessions: name, date, place and whether places are open.
training-sessions.avoid: One or two events with photos: use Featured Event.

fields.title: The heading above the list.
fields.alignment: center (default), left or right for the title and description.

fields.status: The coloured status in the fourth column: accepting-applications, limited-seats, coming-soon, closed or waitlist-open. Only what the source says.
fields.link: Where the arrow goes, e.g. the registration page.

fields.caption: Optional short caption under the badge, e.g. '4-Star Rating'.
fields.badgeLink: Optional link to the rating's own page.

trust-badges.looks: A centred heading and button above a row of badge logos with captions.
trust-badges.avoid: Partner logos without captions: use Logo Carousel or Partners Showcase.

fields.heading: e.g. 'Trusted by donors'.
fields.ctaText: Optional button under the heading, with ctaLink.

us-map.looks: A clickable map of US states linking to state pages, loaded from the backend.
us-map.use: Only on the missing child clearinghouses page, when asked.

video.looks: A video in a 16:9 frame with a placeholder image and a play button; it plays in place.
video.use: One YouTube, Vimeo or MP4 video.
video.avoid: A video with a title, text and buttons beside it: look for a split or resource video block.

fields.url: A YouTube or Vimeo address, or an MP4 path in the DAM.
fields.image: Optional still with a play button; without one the YouTube, Vimeo or MP4 player itself loads in place.
